semantics.THERMAL_LAB: Thermal profile criterion used by the selected reduced column.
semantics.MECHANICAL_LAB: Strength/weakening base; not selected or implied.
semantics.RHEOLOGICAL_LAB: Constitutive threshold; requires rheology and is not selected.
semantics.SEISMIC_LAB: Seismic transition; no ARCANA field or equivalence selected.
semantics.COMPOSITIONAL_LAB: Material interface; not inferred from current domain fields.
semantics.MODEL_DOMAIN_BASE: Computational truncation with declared location and boundary condition, not inherently a physical interface.

selected_initializer_base.continental: Use authored total thickness H as this model's thermal-base location and impose T(H)=T_ad(H); do not relabel H as mechanical LAB, Buck Xe/XL, or a universal physical LAB.
selected_initializer_base.positive_age_ocean: Use the shallowest HWR-2 profile/adiabat crossing; use the HWR finite-plate endpoint only under the source's coupled Tb/zp rule.
selected_initializer_base.ridge: Preserve age zero and use the source-defined effective-age inversion/crossing; fail closed on invalid support or crossing.
selected_initializer_base.physical_equivalence: None asserted to mechanical, rheological, seismic or compositional LAB.

candidate_routes.reason: No criterion required by this recipe; no ARCANA isotherm/solidus authority.
Would require unbound rheology and coupled criterion.
Finite solver support is necessary, but the selected reference recipe retains its own thermal/adiabatic base rule.
Not needed for this model-specific thermal boundary; later Buck mechanics may need separate geometry authority.

boundaries.T0_surface: Existing specialist TSurf=280 K nominal with 250-300 K range and the exact governed domain q rule, initializer only; not a global 210 Ma climate field.
boundaries.T0_basal: Model-specific adiabat/finite-plate thermal boundary; no universal Neumann flux, mantle temperature or physical LAB mapping selected.
boundaries.basal_history_T0_T1: UNKNOWN; no evolution boundary history selected.
boundaries.continental_q_history_T0_T1: UNKNOWN; authored T0 q is not itself a time function.
boundaries.ocean_HWR_history: HWR is age-dependent in its model coordinate; mapping world elapsed time, support motion and ridge/new-crust behavior over this interval is unbound.

controls: Continental H is an authored input; the profile is solved to match its adiabat target, not used to infer H.
Ocean HWR profile is constructed from age and properties before its crossing is evaluated.
No viscosity-derived LAB and no iterative solver.
Do not feed an inferred LAB back into its own profile or rheology without separately governed coupled physics.
